description: This file contains utility functions for processing throughput and data rate data, including formatting data rates, calculating data rates from byte counters, formatting timestamps, preparing data for chart visualization, determining appropriate units for display, and converting data rates to specific units.

methods.name: formatDataRate
methods.description: Converts bytes per second to a human-readable data rate with appropriate units (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps).

methods.name: calculateDataRate
methods.description: Calculates the data rate (rx and tx) between current and previous byte counters over a given interval, handling counter resets.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a UNIX timestamp into a HH:MM:SS string for chart labels.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares dataset and labels for charting by taking recent throughput data points and formatting them appropriately.

methods.name: determineYAxisUnit
methods.description: Decides the best unit (bps, Kbps, Mbps, Gbps) for chart y-axis based on maximum data rate.

methods.name: convertToUnit
methods.description: Converts raw data rates from bytes per second to a specified target unit.

ctags.name: convertToUnit
ctags.pattern: /^export const convertToUnit = (bytesPerSecond: number, targetUnit: string): number => {$/
